tools.name: pluggedin_discover_tools
tools.description: Triggers discovery of tools (and resources/templates) for configured MCP servers in the Pluggedin App.

server_uuid.description: Optional UUID of a specific server to discover. If omitted, attempts to discover all.

force_refresh.description: Set to true to bypass cache and force a fresh discovery. Defaults to false.

inputSchema.description: Triggers tool discovery for configured MCP servers in the Pluggedin App.

tools.name: pluggedin_ask_knowledge_base
tools.description: Ask questions and get AI-generated answers from your knowledge base. Returns structured JSON with answer, document sources, and metadata.

query.description: Your question or query to get AI-generated answers from the knowledge base.

inputSchema.description: Ask questions and get AI-generated answers from your knowledge base. Returns JSON with answer, sources, and metadata.

tools.name: pluggedin_send_notification
tools.description: Send custom notifications through the Plugged.in system with optional email delivery. You can provide a custom title or let the system use a localized default.

title.description: Optional notification title. If not provided, a localized default will be used. Consider generating a descriptive title based on the message content.

severity.description: The severity level of the notification (defaults to INFO)

sendEmail.description: Whether to also send the notification via email

tools.name: pluggedin_list_notifications
tools.description: List notifications from the Plugged.in system with optional filters for unread only and result limit

onlyUnread.description: Filter to show only unread notifications

limit.description: Limit the number of notifications returned (1-100)

tools.name: pluggedin_mark_notification_done
tools.description: Mark a notification as done in the Plugged.in system

notificationId.description: The ID of the notification to mark as read

tools.name: pluggedin_delete_notification
tools.description: Delete a notification from the Plugged.in system

notificationId.description: The ID of the notification to delete

prompts.name: pluggedin_proxy_capabilities
prompts.description: Learn about the Plugged.in MCP Proxy capabilities and available tools
